_comment: SWaT physical invariants for the NIO v2 physics-residual detector. Coefficients for mass balance are fit on normal data at runtime; this file declares the topology (which flows feed/drain each tank) and the actuator-flow interlocks, derived from the SWaT P&ID and confirmed by correlating d(level)/dt against flows on normal data.

actuator_flow_interlock._rule: P101 off => FIT201 ~ 0 (raw-water pump feeds Stage 2)
